publication.locator: 'How much money will this save?', first paragraph

quote: The mean savings are £3 billion (annually) by 2034/35 rising to £57.4 billion (annually) by 2049/50.
note: The post is dated 2 October 2026; the calculator's model changed on 1 and 5 October and its figures were re-exported on 6 October (Methodology page; staged below). publication.title: How much will the government's Triple Lock reform save? (Lawrence and Stubbs)
publication.locator: 'How much money will this save?', third paragraph

quote: The Department for Work and Pensions has forecast that the change will raise £15 billion in 2039/40 and £50 billion in 2049/50.
